'''Harper Krass''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] who hid in the abandoned cities of [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]], where, as he claimed, ghosts and other evil powers resided.

==Biography==
In the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]'s existence,<ref name="CE" /> the talented but remorseless Harper Krass joined the criminal syndicate [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], acting to advance the organization's interests on<ref name="WC" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]' planet<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] through [[Assassin/Legends|assassinations]] and various acts of [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorism]]. Krass's ruthlessness earned him widespread notoriety, but he eventually went into self-imposed exile on the planet [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]] for a number of reasons,<ref name="WC" /> including to avoid arrest.<ref name="CE" />

[[File:Vulpter_FF7.jpg|left|thumb|Harper Krass established his own syndicate on the planet Vulpter]]
While in exile, Krass hoped to expand Black Sun's influence into the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] and viewed Vulpter as a suitable first step toward that goal. His operations on the planet remained discreet, yet their impact proved significant. Over time, he established his own fledgling syndicate and began preparing to seize control of Vulpter's criminal underworld. However, the powerful [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], which effectively controlled most economic activity on the planet, grew concerned about Krass's expanding influence and alerted the Republic's [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]] to the whereabouts of the wanted terrorist. Krass was reported to be hiding among the ruins of one of Vulpter's abandoned [[City/Legends|cities]], a place rumored to be haunted by [[Ghost (folklore)/Legends|ghosts]].<ref name="WC" /> He was eventually brought to justice, but told stories of ghosts and other evil powers lurking beneath the city on Vulpter.<ref name="CE" /> These stories led some to speculate that he had fallen under the spell of dark powers.<ref name="WC" />

==Personality and abilities==
Harper Krass was a slender [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] with jet-black [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and a menacing gaze. He was known for his cold composure and calculating nature, traits that allowed him not only to survive within the criminal underworld but also to construct and expand his own network of influence.<ref name="WC" />

A skilled manipulator, Krass excelled in persuasion, deception, and intimidation, frequently relying on lies, forged identities, and psychological pressure to achieve his goals. He was also an experienced combatant, proficient with weapons such as [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistols]] and [[Knife/Legends|knives]], and capable of reacting quickly in dangerous situations. His talents extended to illicit trade, information gathering, and covert operations, making him a versatile and dangerous operative within Black Sun's ranks.<ref name="WC" />

Krass's reputation for infamy and his willingness to employ terror tactics further reinforced his status as a feared figure among both criminals and law enforcement, even as his activities on Vulpter were conducted largely from the shadows.<ref name="WC" />

==Behind the scenes==
A character summary of Harper Krass was presented by [[Wizards of the Coast]] on the [[Wizards.com|official website]] in a supplementary article dedicated to the planet Vulpter for their [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|own roleplaying game]] in [[2005]]. This non-player character served as a key element in the adventure scenario «Ghosts in the Darkness», in which players were tasked with capturing a wanted criminal among the ruins of an abandoned city. At the beginning of the story, it was specified that the time period of the scenario, at the players’ discretion, did not have to take place during the era of the Republic, but could also be set during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] or the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

In [[2008]], the reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' officially established that the events of the scenario «Ghosts in the Darkness» took place during the Galactic Republic era. Nevertheless, the encyclopedic entry on Harper Krass did not mention Vulpter, which may have led to the mistaken assumption that he was hiding in the underground levels of the [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on Coruscant.
